summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom regarding women hearing the reading of Parashat Zachor in Middle Eastern communities. He reviews the opinions of various Sephardic and Ashkenazi authorities on whether women are obligated to attend this reading.
questions: Are women obligated to hear Parashat Zachor?
What was the custom in Middle Eastern communities regarding women and Parashat Zachor?
Did Hacham Ovadia Yosef allow reading Parashat Zachor for women in the afternoon?
What was the custom in Halab regarding women and Parashat Zachor?
